course_title: Implementing and Auditing Information Security Management Systems
description: This course covers the implementation and auditing of Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) using ISO/IEC 27001 standards. Topics include risk assessment methodologies such as OCTAVE and FAIR; implementation of control objectives for information security (COBIT); configuration of firewalls using Cisco ASA and Palo Alto Networks; penetration testing with Kali Linux tools; audit planning using ISO 19011; security incident response using NIST SP 800-61; and compliance with GDPR and HIPAA regulations. Students will also explore cryptographic algorithms such as AES and RSA, and the use of SIEM tools like Splunk and ELK for log analysis and security monitoring.

clos.text: Define the components of an Information Security Management System (ISMS) based on ISO/IEC 27001 standards.
Describe the risk assessment methodologies including OCTAVE and FAIR, and their application in organizational risk management.
Explain the implementation of control objectives for information security (COBIT) and their alignment with business goals.
Apply penetration testing techniques using Kali Linux tools to identify vulnerabilities in networked systems.
Implement an audit plan based on ISO 19011 standards to evaluate the effectiveness of an ISMS.
